summary: Bluerock Private Real Estate Fund filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a shelf takedown of up to 25 million preferred shares (Series A and Series B convertible perpetual preferred, $10 liquidation preference, 7.00% dividend) and common shares issuable on conversion. This is an ordinary capital raise by a closed-end fund, not a special situation event. No special-situation mechanics or structural changes beyond routine securities offering.
